title: Turkish Borek Beef Pastries
description: Delicious Turkish borek filled with tender beef and spices, perfect as a snack or light meal.
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Season the beef mixture with salt, black pepper, and Turkish spice mix.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Spoon the beef mixture onto the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the phyllo dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the borek with melted butter and cut into serving pieces.
Bake the borek in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
